name: Zagreb Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars (backfill; not independently verified): 182 recurring closures (all named), no early closes, and 3 one-off closures moved to ad_hoc_closures (lesson 13), each confirmed by the exchange: 29 and 30 December 2022 (no trading on the euro changeover; ZSE's 'Resolution on amendments to the trading calendar in 2022' of 8 September 2022, https://zse.hr/en/resolution-on-amendments-to-the-trading-calendar-in-2022/2503) and 17 April 2024 (parliamentary election day; ZSE's 'Resolution on amending the resolution on the trading calendar in 2024', https://zse.hr/en/resolution-on-amending-the-resolution-on-the-trading-calendar-in-2024/2810, which also lists the full 2024 non-trading days, matching exchange_calendars' 14 weekday closures). Holiday creation dates: exchange_calendars follows the 2019 amendment of the Croatian holidays act (in force 2020): Independence Day (8 October) closes only to 2019, Statehood Day moves from 25 June (to 2019) to 30 May (first weekday 2022), and Remembrance Day (18 November) starts in 2020; nothing is closed before its law, so nothing is removed. The act itself was not re-read in 4c11. Corrections: 0. 2025-2027: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2028-2029: standing pattern. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c11). Last published year: ZSE's non-trading days page (https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110) lists 2026 and 2027, and the 'Trading calendar in 2027' post of 9 September 2026 (https://zse.hr/en/trading-calendar-in-2027/3574) lists the 2027 days; the registry's 2026 and 2027 weekday closures match both exactly (their existing citations are kept). Close (ADR 0013): ZSE's Trading Manual of 14 January 2026, in force 22 January 2026 (https://zse.hr/UserDocsImages/docs/trading/manuals/Trading_Manual_2026-01-14.pdf), gives for Continuous Trading: pre-trading 08:00-09:00, opening auction 09:00-09:30, continuous trading 09:30-12:00, intraday auction 12:00-12:10, continuous trading 12:10-15:55, closing auction 15:55-16:00 (earliest ending; the end is random, up to 15 seconds later), trading at close 16:00-16:10 and post-trading 16:10-16:25. ADR 0013 ignores the random window, so the close is 16:00, unchanged (the file and exchange_calendars both have 16:00); the open stays 09:30, the start of continuous trading (exchange_calendars has 09:00, the opening auction). One dated entry from 2010-01-01, unconfirmed: the manual is the 2026 version; the 2017 Xetra T7 migration and the December 2019 schedule were read only through custodian newsflashes. The intraday auction (12:00-12:10) and trading at close are not modelled. No shortened trading days are in the manual or the calendars.
